devices: welded capsule waveform — EQ bars fused into one continuous ribbon via rounded negative-space notches, not discrete sticks
two isolated bookend dots flanking the ribbon (quiet start/end-of-recording markers)
vertically-offset inner nubs (high-left, low-right) giving a subtle oscillation instead of a static mirror
single flat brand-azure fill, no glyph gradient
rhymes_hint: flat mono-glyph on cool near-white ramp (restrained end of Big Sur unified) + Audio-category waveform convention (Voice Memos lineage); welded-ribbon device is the differentiator
notes: Full 1024x1024 vector-crisp, trustworthy resolution (not a resized web render). BUT it is a macapp.supply presentation render: transparent corners (a=0) + baked system drop shadow — rounded-rect mask already applied, so mask discipline judged from the masked presentation not the raw full-bleed layer. Era-lag: a 2026 Audio app on flat Big Sur-era language (no Liquid Glass, no specular/translucency, no Icon Composer variants). Brand blue #1678E6 is a custom azure, slightly deeper/less-cyan than kit system blue light #0088FF; coherent with cover title blue and UI accent. Score of 12/12 reflects technical/compositional soundness, not distinctiveness — the icon is rubric-perfect precisely because it takes zero risks.
